title: Feasibility of measuring condylar inclination from facial scans using eccentric interocclusal records across different intercondylar distances: An in vitro study using a TMJ simulation model
html: Although digital prosthodontic workflows have improved anatomic data acquisition for articulator mounting and jaw simulation, virtual articulator systems still commonly rely on average intercondylar distance values and standardized mounting procedures, limiting the simulation of patient-specific mandibular movement.
